description: This file declares functions related to managing process groups within the c10d distributed package of PyTorch, including registration, resolution, and thread mode settings.

methods.name: set_thread_isolation_mode
methods.description: Sets the thread isolation mode; enables or disables thread isolation for distributed operations.

methods.name: get_thread_isolation_mode
methods.description: Returns whether thread isolation mode is currently enabled.

methods.name: register_process_group
methods.description: Registers a new process group with the specified name.

methods.name: resolve_process_group
methods.description: Resolves and returns the process group associated with the given name.

methods.name: unregister_process_group
methods.description: Unregisters the process group associated with the specified name.
